name: Christian Jobelius Schulz
seoTitle: Christian Jobelius Schulz - PhD Student in Econometrics
bio: I am a PhD Student in Econometrics at the University of Duisburg-Essen. I am part of the Ruhr Graduate School in Economics and a member of the TRR 391. I worked in the Monetary Policy and Analysis Division of the Deutsche Bundesbank and I am currently visiting the Monetary Policy Department of the Bank of England as a PhD Intern. I co-organize the RuhrMetrics Reading Group. My research focuses on Time Series Econometrics, Machine Learning, and Forecasting for Macro(-Finance) and Energy.
